title: Vivijure Wan Cast Training
description: Cast (character) LoRA training for Vivijure. Pulls a cast bundle of reference stills from your Cloudflare R2 bucket, trains a Wan 2.2 A14B dual-expert character adapter, and uploads both experts back to R2 as loras/<project>/<slot>/wan_{high,low}_noise.safetensors for your Studio to use at image-to-video time. Base weights are baked into the image, so the worker runs fully offline with no download step. Requires a Cloudflare R2 bucket shared with your Vivijure Studio.

input.name: R2 S3 endpoint
input.description: Your Cloudflare R2 S3 endpoint, e.g. https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com (this worker reads R2_ENDPOINT, not R2_ENDPOINT_URL)

input.name: R2 access key ID
input.description: The public half of your R2 storage key.

input.name: R2 secret access key
input.description: The secret half of your R2 storage key. Keep it private.

input.name: R2 bucket
input.description: The R2 bucket shared with your Vivijure Studio.
